summary.text: Kevin Avard is a Republican state senator from Nashua, New Hampshire, who has represented District 12 since December 2020 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner, with a career that includes owning a contract cleaning service.

paragraphs.text: Avard lives in Nashua, New Hampshire, and his career experience includes owning a contract cleaning service.

He served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 20 from 2010 to 2012 and in the State Senate for District 12 from 2014 to 2018 before returning to the Senate in December 2020.
In the 2025-2026 session Avard chairs the Energy and Natural Resources Committee and the Rules and Enrolled Bills Committee and is vice chair of the Health and Human Services Committee.
